title: 惯性约束聚变中激光脉冲波形设计的逆向建模
summary: 提出LPDS生成式逆向建模框架，将期望结果与靶丸配置直接映射为优化的激光脉冲波形，设计多目标损失函数满足物理约束，并提供约束条件化、修复和基于梯度的编辑机制实现细粒度控制。
summary_en: Introduces LPDS, a generative inverse modeling framework that maps desired outcomes and target pellet configurations directly to optimized laser pulse shapes, with a multi-objective loss enforcing physical constraints and constraint-conditioning, inpainting, and gradient-based editing for fine-grained control.
